title: automation: tenant RBAC bootstrap + private installer - improved defaults and terraform module
author: Ava Martinez
description:
Motivation: Private deployments require a repeatable, secure bootstrap flow to create tenant-scoped roles, service accounts, and initial policies without manual intervention. This PR automates RBAC bundle generation and wiring for the Private installer (VPC/on-prem), updates the Terraform rbac module to expose necessary inputs, and adds safe upgrade/rollback hooks to the Helm charts.

What this PR does:
- Adds a new bootstrap flow (installer/private/bootstrap-rbac.sh) that creates tenant roles and bindings using the policy bundle in a non-interactive mode. The script supports KMS-backed secrets and HSM-encrypted keys used by Private.
- Introduces terraform/modules/rbac: new variable inputs for tenant_id, bootstrap_service_account, and policy_overrides plus improved documentation and examples. Backwards compatible defaults retained.
- Helm chart changes (charts/private/templates/*): additional ClusterRole/Role templates for tenant isolation, and post-upgrade hooks to validate role reconciliation.
- Policy bundle updates (policies/tenant-bootstrap/*): curated least-privilege roles for installer, operator, and monitoring personas; explicit deny rules for cross-tenant access.
- Migration helpers (scripts/migrations/rbac-migrate-2025-11.sh) to run during private installer upgrades to move existing role bindings to the new tenant-scoped principals.
- E2E tests and CI: added tests/e2e/priv-installer-rbac.test.ts to validate bootstrap and upgrade paths in a simulated private cluster.

Checklist:
- [x] Terraform module updated and validated (terraform validate + fmt)
- [x] Helm templates linted (helm lint) and post-upgrade hooks added
- [x] Migration script included and smoke-tested locally
- [x] E2E tests added and passing in CI (flaky test retried and passed)
- [x] Docs updated with examples (README.md in terraform/modules/rbac and charts/private/README.md)

Migration notes and risk mitigation:
- The terraform module maintains old inputs; existing deployments will continue to function without changes. To opt-in to tenant-scoped principals, supply the new bootstrap_service_account and tenant_id variables.
- The migration script is idempotent and safe to run multiple times. It performs read-only validation before applying changes and logs a dry-run report.
- Helm post-upgrade hooks validate role bindings and will roll back the release if critical invariants fail. This keeps upgrade risk low for on-prem customers.

Testing and validation steps (how to run locally):
1) Clone repo and run: ./installer/private/bootstrap-rbac.sh --dry-run --tenant my-tenant --sa bootstrap-sa
2) Apply terraform example in terraform/examples/private-rbac with provided variables and run terraform plan/apply
3) Install helm chart: helm install redwood-private charts/private -f charts/private/values-rbac.yaml then helm upgrade --install with the post-upgrade hooks enabled
4) Run e2e: yarn test:e2e tests/e2e/priv-installer-rbac.test.ts

Related: linear/ENG-1423 for automation scope, ENG-1765 for helm hooks and rollback policy. Contact @ravi or @ava for runbook details.

review_conversation: Ravi Patel: Can we avoid any cluster-admin escalation in the bootstrap path? Suggest making the script request minimal privileges and create a temporary elevated SA that is revoked after bootstrap.

Ava Martinez: Agreed. Updated the bootstrap script to use a short-lived bootstrap SA when cluster-admin is required and revoke it as the final step. Documented the flow in terraform/modules/rbac/README.md.
Elena Gomez: Helm hooks look good; one nit: make the post-upgrade job respect existing timeouts in the chart values (added values.timeout.postUpgrade).
Ava Martinez: Addressed in charts/private/values-rbac.yaml and added unit test for hook timeout handling.
Marcus Li: E2E flake on first run (timing). CI rerun passed. Recommend adding retries in the test to reduce flakiness.
Ava Martinez: Added a retry helper in tests/fixtures and increased visibility logs for timing-sensitive assertions.
release_notes: Adds automated tenant RBAC bootstrap flow for Private deployments, updates Terraform rbac module with new opt-in inputs, improves Helm chart role templates and post-upgrade validation hooks, includes migration script and e2e tests.
notes_for_ops: Run scripts/migrations/rbac-migrate-2025-11.sh during installer upgrades. If using VPC private installer, set terraform var bootstrap_service_account to enable automated tenant creation. See terraform/modules/rbac/README.md for details.
risk_assessment: Low-medium: changes are opt-in at terraform/helm level. Migration script is idempotent and Helm hooks will roll back on invariant failures. No breaking API changes.
